items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: That's the one this man Benny Goodman talked about.

ctx.x: Well, how was the Keppard compared with that one?

Keppard was in there, Freddie. Oh, yeah. Freddie was a bad trumpet player too. He was powerful like Joe Oliver and I think he was a better musician, Joe Oliver, Freddie Keppard. Because he was a good violin player, see? Yeah. And the voice of music was nothing. He had that down but he just had to get the finger in the trumpet. I think it was better trumpet player than Joe Oliver. That's the one this man Benny Goodman talked about. Yeah. He had a tone like Kid Rene. Shockey Banana, you ever listen to his tone?…
Well, Rene learned Shockey. Yeah, he learned from Rene.
